title: Memory Stargraph

remote_mcp.config_secret_policy: owner-only files; no secrets in repository or dashboard config

summary: Launches the local Memory Stargraph entity graph service and exposes live source status for dashboard cards or quick links.
notes: Use this artifact when the dashboard repo is not present in the current workspace.
Service is local-only and expected to bind to 127.0.0.1.
The version-controlled launcher provides an isolated remote_mcp identity and fails closed instead of falling back to local PGlite data.
If live gbrain access fails, the UI will show cache or demo mode explicitly.
